content:
Alex: Quick heads-up — ACME just signaled they need a private deploy with model-quantization support in Q3. We should consider swapping sprints to meet their pilot window. Who can map deps?
Priya: Can you paste ACME's acceptance criteria? Are they asking for p95 latency SLAs or just qualitative perf?
Alex: Pinged customer. They want p95 < 150ms, EU data residency, KMS integration, and ability to rollback to fp16. Pilot requested in ~6 weeks.
Jamal: 6 weeks is tight. Runtime needs ~2 weeks to add 8-bit quant path + perf tests. Infra needs time for VPC peering and capacity reservations.
Rachel: Security: KMS + audit logs are fine but on-prem connectors need a threat model. We'll need ~1 week for review and remediation plan.
Sasha: Product ops: if we prioritize ACME, we must de-scope two items this sprint: "ensemble routing" and "ui telemetry 2.0". Heads-up.
Priya: Tradeoffs: minimal MVP could be API-only single-region EU, no UI work, and we can cut ensemble. That reduces scope a lot.
Jamal: Can we reuse existing quant infra (redwood-quant-lib)? If yes, saves ~1 week. If not, expect 3 days CI plumbing + 7 days dev.
Alex: Assume we can reuse redwood-quant-lib v0.8 but will need a canary rollout and auto-fallback to fp16 on perf regressions.
Rachel: Security will sign off if there is canary + full KMS audit events for every model load + IAC changes reviewed for VPC peering.
Sasha: Product needs guarantee of customer acceptance tests. We need a prompt/eval suite and a pass threshold (e.g., 95% parity vs baseline).
Priya: I'll own the eval set and gating. Suggest soft SLA: 99.5% uptime during pilot and documented rollback criteria.
Jamal: Proposed rollout: dev branch -> internal perf run -> canary (10% in EU) -> scale to 100% if perf within 10% of baseline. Auto-fallback on regression.
Alex: Assign owners: @Jamal runtime, @Sasha coordinate de-scopes, @Rachel security review, @Priya customer comms + evals.
InfraBot: deploy-scheduler: VPC peering slot available in EU region on 2026-04-07.
Priya: Timeline sketch: Day0: confirm scope. +1 week design spec. +2 weeks runtime prototype. +1 week security review. +2 weeks canary + customer validation = ~6 weeks.
Rachel: I'll start the threat model doc and block reviewers.
Jamal: I'll post perf benchmark guidance and CI snippet shortly. Quick run command for perf team:
```
pytest tests/perf/test_quant.py::PerfSuite -k eu --runs=5
```
Priya: OK. Treat as sprint priority-1 for next planning. I'll update roadmap and de-prioritize ensemble & telemetry 2.0.
Alex: Thanks all — I'll update ACME with revised timeline and scope today. :thumbsup:
